name: – David McAllister – After § 29 – Am 39
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – 2024 annual report
part_text: 29c. Strongly condemns Israel’s cutting off of humanitarian aid and electricity to Gaza, actions that constitute clear violations of international humanitarian law; further condemns Israel’s surprise attack on Gaza, beginning on the night of 16 March 2025, which not only ended the ceasefire and reignited the conflict but also resulted in over 1 000 deaths within just 48 hours;
